name: frameplan_edit_roundtrip
description: N-8: connect a resource on the Frame Plan canvas by dragging one socket onto a pass, watch the read appear, cut it again by dragging the input away, move a node and follow the placement out through set_layout and back in from disk, then open the Pass Editor after a named node.

steps.label: the engine viewport answers editor RPC
the first frame plan has arrived
steps.name: pelican.framePlanStatus

steps.label: look at the authored pass's own target
steps.name: pelican.framePlanTarget

steps.label: and at everything that reaches it
steps.name: pelican.framePlanDepth

steps.label: the canvas has drawn the authored pass
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node#n8_probe_pass

steps.label: show the whole graph so both ends of the drag are on screen
steps.name: pelican.framePlan.fitView

steps.label: the authored pass's own input socket is drawn, named by side and resource
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node_socket#n8_probe_pass/in:lit_color

steps.label: and so is the output socket the drag will start from
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node_socket#ssao_blur_pass/out:ssao_blur

steps.label: the authored pass does not read ssao_blur yet
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node_socket#n8_probe_pass/in:ssao_blur

steps.label: its shader (engine://fullscreen) declares binding 1 as well, which lit_color does not feed (VI-3a)
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node_socket#n8_probe_pass/in@1

steps.label: drag the ssao_blur output socket onto the authored pass's binding 1, the next one
the engine's own frame plan now reads it, which is what draws the socket
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node_socket#n8_probe_pass/in:ssao_blur

steps.label: fit the view again over the redrawn graph
steps.name: pelican.framePlan.fitView

steps.label: drag that input socket off its node, which cuts the read
the read is gone from the canvas again
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node_socket#n8_probe_pass/in:ssao_blur

steps.label: fit the view once more before moving a node
steps.name: pelican.framePlan.fitView

steps.label: move the authored pass by its heading, away from where it was placed
the placement reached the document through set_layout, after the debounce
and the graph canvas's own half of the same member is still there
pick the first pass of the graph
steps.name: pelican.framePlanLogicalView::node#gbuffer_pass

steps.label: Add fullscreen pass, fired by name rather than through a popup
steps.name: pelican.framePlan.addFullscreenPass

steps.label: the Pass Editor stands at the engine's anchor after the first pass, not at the end
steps.name: pelican.fullscreenPass.position

steps.label: open a second, untouched copy of the same fixture
the switched-to engine answers editor RPC
the untouched copy keeps no placement, so this is not a memory of the session
come back to the edited project, which the engine re-reads from disk
the re-read engine answers editor RPC
the placement survived the round trip through disk
a picture of the Frame Plan canvas for the reader of this report
steps.name: pelican.framePlan
